name: 105 mm howitzer M2A1
about: Made by tools/battle-models (gun). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 shade, 3 track, 4 rubber, 5 steel, 6 bright, 7 wood, 8 canvas, 9 glass, 10 black, 11 rust, 12 lamp, 13 white, 14 red, 15 yellow, 16 blue, 17 leather, 18 torn, 19 rope, 20 cloth, 21 skin, 22 brass

parts.name: vehicle
parts.note: on the ground under the middle of her axle, x toward the muzzle; the game moves and turns this

parts.name: carriage
parts.note: the axle and all that stands on it: + muzzle up about the axle (clips tip her about her spades and lift her trail to the limber)

parts.name: traverse
parts.note: trains on the bottom carriage: + to the right (clockwise from above); the game lays it inside its limits

parts.name: gun
parts.note: the cradle lifts at the trunnions: + muzzle up; the game lays it

parts.name: barrel
parts.note: runs back along its own length when she fires (metres)

parts.name: handwheel_elevate
parts.note: the layer's handwheel: spins as the gun is laid

parts.name: handwheel_traverse
parts.note: the layer's handwheel: spins as the gun is laid

parts.name: trail_l
parts.note: a leg of the trail: + closes it for the road (0 is spread for action)

parts.name: trail_r
parts.note: a leg of the trail: + closes it for the road (0 is spread for action)

sockets.name: breech
sockets.note: the breech face: where the round goes in

sockets.name: grip.layer.l
sockets.note: the layer's left hand on the elevating wheel's handle: it goes round with the wheel

sockets.name: grip.layer.r
sockets.note: the layer's right hand on the traversing wheel's handle: it goes round with the wheel

sockets.name: tow
sockets.note: the towing eye: it goes on the lorry's hook

sockets.name: dust.muzzle
sockets.note: the ground under the muzzle: the blast lifts the dust here

sockets.name: crew.layer
sockets.note: the layer, at the sight and the handwheels

sockets.name: crew.ammo
sockets.note: the man who hands the rounds up

sockets.name: ammo
sockets.note: where the boxes of rounds stand

fire.about: she fires: flash and blast at 0.0, the piece runs back at once and out again over a second, her wheels jump and settle; the breech is thrown open at 1.2 and the empty case falls, the next round goes in and it closes at 2.05

limber.about: out of action: the trail is closed and lifted to the lorry's hook (the men do it: play it with them)

unlimber.about: into action: off the hook, the trail dropped and spread, the spades down

towed.about: on the road behind her lorry: trail closed and on the hook, she bounces a little (the game rolls her wheels and moves her)

knocked_out.about: knocked out: struck at 0.0, her right wheel is smashed off and she drops on the axle, the piece falls to its stop; holds its last pose

traverse.what: trained by the game inside its limits: + to the right

gun.what: laid by the game inside its limits: + muzzle up

trail.what: + closes each leg for the road; the limber and unlimber clips do it

running.how: turn each wheel by (distance run on its side) / radius, in radians; play tracks.left and tracks.right at (speed of that side) / stride * long
